description: This file defines a ToastService class in C# used for displaying toast notifications with different levels (Info, Success, Warning, Error) in a Blazor web application. It manages showing and hiding toast messages with a countdown timer.

classes.name: ToastLevel
classes.description: An enum representing different levels of toast notifications.

classes.name: ToastService
classes.description: Service class responsible for managing toast notifications, including showing messages and automatic hiding after a countdown.

methods.name: ShowToast
methods.description: Triggers the display of a toast message with a specific level and starts the countdown to hide it.

methods.name: StartCountdown
methods.description: Initializes and restarts the countdown timer for hiding the toast.

methods.name: SetCountdown
methods.description: Creates and configures the countdown timer if it hasn't been initialized.

methods.name: HideToast
methods.description: Event handler that is called when the timer elapses, triggering the hiding of the toast.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the timer resource when the service is no longer needed.
